name: NationGate Holdings Berhad
summary: NationGate Holdings Berhad, an investment holding company, provides electronic manufacturing services. It is involved in the assembly and testing of electronic components and products to produce completed printed circuit boards, semi-finished subassemblies, and fully assembled electronic products, as well as semiconductor devices. The company also engages in the manufacture of servers, server racks, network switches, and other electronic components; warehousing, manufacturer, general carriers, agents, importers and exporters, wholesalers and retailers, and general trading activities; and provision of logistics services.
